about_the_game:
1. Design Your Dream Cat Café

Step into your furry boss role! Customize every detail – arrange furniture, decorate walls, and design paw-some zones. Unlock tons of cat-themed items, mix-and-match styles, and create your ultimate cozy hangout. Deck out comfy nooks with plush pillows, fresh flowers, and cute decor where cats can chill and nap in style.

2. Cook Up Purr-fect Cat Treats

Master two key areas:

☕ Coffee Bar: Grind beans, whip up chocolatey lattes, and craft signature drinks

🍪 Bakery: Knead dough, swirl fruit jams, and bake cat-safe goodies

Level up to unlock new recipes and keep customers coming back for more!

3. Hire Your Purr-sonal Dream Team

Recruit expert kitties:

• Purristas: Craft paw-some beverages

• Meowffin Makers: Bake drool-worthy snacks

• Cashier Cats: Speed through orders

• Clean-up Crew: Keep the joint spotless

Train your squad, kit them out with cute gear, and run a purr-fessional operation!

4. Grow Your Kitty Empire

Start small in your tiny shop and level up your biz! Earn coins and XP to expand your space. Unlock the Bakery Mode later – get ovens and decorating stations to create cat cakes and pawprint cookies. Personalize your café with wall art, rugs, and themed decorations to attract rare cats who’ll become your café’s main attraction!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 - bit
  • Processor: Quad - core Intel or AMD, 2.5GHz or faster.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Build your dream cat café! Design cozy spaces with cute furniture, bake cat-themed treats, and hire fluffy staff (baristas, bakers, cashiers). Grow from a small shop to a feline empire by unlocking bakery equipment and decorations. Attract unique cats to be your café's star attraction!
